QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Unsettling Future 5
QuestInfo.0: You need time to come up with a plan.
QuestInfo.1: How is it outside of Twilight Perion? Go find out. Hunting #r20 Swollen Stumps#k will give you a sense of things.
QuestInfo.2: The monsters in Twilight Perion have become ferocious, just like in the Henesys Ruins.

0.0: (How is it outside of town? Did the monsters become ferocious, just like in Henesys Ruins? I should go see for myself.)

yes.0: (I'm going to take down #r20 of those Swollen Stumps#k and see what's up.)

1.0: (The monsters are much tougher now, just like in the Henesys Ruins.)

yes.0: (Future Perion has the turncoat Resistance inside the town and violent monsters outside of town...)
yes.1: (I can't imagine what it must be like to live with this kind of nightmare every day.)
